tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The desk under every screen: luminous paper light by day, a calm night page after dark.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The soft light at the top of the desk. Only ever a wash behind a screen, never a fill.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Paper: the notes, the script, menus, the composer, toasts.

tokens.name: card-2
tokens.usage: A second sheet: Details, a hovered row, the script's margin.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Where footage sits, and the soft tint behind the user's words.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between things.

tokens.name: line-mid
tokens.usage: The edge of a button or a chip.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: The edge of anything you type into: 3:1 against the paper it sits on.

tokens.name: beat
tokens.usage: A beat on the strip in v1, the white pages.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, and the one filled button a view may have.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Times, counts, captions under things. Still 4.5:1 on paper and desk.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Now: the playhead, and the mark's dashed bar. Never text, never a fill, never a second time on a screen.

tokens.name: pick
tokens.usage: Blue pencil: a stretch picked on the strip, and the script lines it covers.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Something went wrong, said beside where it happened, with an icon as well as the colour.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Saved, done, connected.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Behind footage: a frame before its picture loads, letterboxing, caption samples.

tokens.name: frame-2
tokens.usage: The lighter end of an empty frame's wash.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected text.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: The near edge of a lifted sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-deep
tokens.usage: The soft fall of light under a lifted sheet.

tokens.name: rev-1
tokens.usage: Revision colour for v1, the white pages (shown as the beat grey so beats still read).

tokens.name: rev-2
tokens.usage: v2, the blue pages.

tokens.name: rev-3
tokens.usage: v3, the pink pages.

tokens.name: rev-4
tokens.usage: v4, the yellow pages.

tokens.name: rev-5
tokens.usage: v5, the green pages.

tokens.name: rev-6
tokens.usage: v6, the goldenrod pages. Then the colours begin again.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: One question per screen, at most. Start uses it.

styles.name: page
styles.usage: The title of a page: a brand's name, Settings, Library.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark beside the mark. Always lower case.

styles.name: reply
styles.sample: v2 is ready. I took out the long pause before the hook, so it opens on the kitchen line.
styles.usage: What the assistant says, at a reading measure of about 62 characters.

styles.name: script
styles.sample: Grace looks like a kitchen table.
styles.usage: The words of the edit in the script panel.

styles.name: margin
styles.sample: Hold on her face a beat longer
styles.usage: Notes pencilled in the script's margin. Italic.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: A chat's or an edit's title, the top of a panel.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Keep the calendar shot in colour.
styles.usage: Your own words, lists, most interface text.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates, counts, captions under thumbnails. Set in muted, tabular figures.

styles.name: command
styles.usage: Preset commands, timecode and file names. Nothing else is mono.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside tight groups: a label and its count.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips and between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a thumbnail and its caption, list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between panels, inside small cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Inside the notes and the script.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, the gap between a reply and its buttons.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side margins.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between turns in a thread.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Breathing room above a screen's title.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: The air at the top of Start.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: The assistant's tile, small marks, chips that are not commands.

tokens.name: radius-thumb
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, posters, Details.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Sheets of paper: the notes, the script, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-composer
tokens.usage: The composer and the footage well.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, commands, segmented controls.

tokens.name: shadow-composer
tokens.usage: The composer: paper lifted a little off the desk.

tokens.name: shadow-frame
tokens.usage: The video frame.

tokens.name: shadow-tab
tokens.usage: The current revision tab and the pill of a segmented control.

tokens.name: shadow-page
tokens.usage: A sheet resting on the desk: the notes, the script.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Things above everything else: menus, toasts.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press and focus: colour, border, a button pressing in.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menus, toggles, small things changing.

tokens.name: duration-gentle
tokens.usage: Arrivals: a reply, a note, a revision.

tokens.name: duration-calm
tokens.usage: Moving between places: a screen, the composer, footage growing into the preview.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Moving between places.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Arrivals: quick to start, then floating to rest.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Leaving: also an ease-out, and shorter than arriving. Nothing eases in.

tokens.name: spring-gentle
tokens.usage: Things a hand moves: a switch, the pill of a segmented control. Settles without overshooting.
